goal: Expand M-Osugi1230/jquants-research-studio's investment information coverage while strictly preventing provider API-limit exhaustion. Preserve the current production architecture and all already-working market, earnings, Yield, Charts, Research, and Workspace behavior. First maximize information derived from data already stored in Supabase/raw/archive tables so those additions require zero new external API calls; prioritize useful valuation, profitability, growth, financial-health, liquidity/volume/volatility, event, and decision-support fields that can be computed deterministically from existing data. Then add only bounded incremental ingestion for genuinely missing high-value information where an approved existing source/provider supports it, preferring bulk/date-scoped endpoints and public/no-key sources over per-security API loops. Never implement an unbounded all-security per-symbol fetch. Reuse existing caches, cursors, raw records, event queues, deduplication, and point-in-time semantics. Centralize or strengthen provider-budget controls so every external fetch path fails closed when allowance is unknown, honors configured rate limits and Retry-After, avoids duplicate retries, records request/usage state, and resumes later instead of bypassing limits. For EDINET DB, preserve the hard Free-plan 100 requests/day model, live /usage check, at least five requests of reserve, maximum two provider calls per company, retry deferral, and existing newest-first queue policy; do not increase current scheduled request ceilings. For J-Quants, preserve the existing persistent rate limiter and configured requests-per-minute ceiling, use incremental/date-batched retrieval, and do not raise the configured limit. Do not create additional accounts, rotate credentials, parallelize around provider limits, or otherwise circumvent quotas. Do not access or expose secrets. Changes must be repository code/tests/migrations/Edge Function definitions only; production-destructive operations, credential changes, paid-plan upgrades, or provider-policy exceptions require HUMAN_WAIT. Add deterministic tests proving no-limit-bypass behavior, idempotent/resumable ingestion, and that zero-call derived-data work does not trigger provider requests. Use the minimum bounded task DAG, require target CI for each implementation, and prefer completing one safe data-expansion vertical slice end-to-end before broadening scope.
